title: Process-wide TLS verification off via process.env.NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED = "0"; (javascript) — review required
description: The javascript environment assignment process.env.NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED = "0"; turns certificate verification off for every TLS client in the process. Verification is the only defence against an active interceptor presenting its own certificate. Remove it and fix the trust store instead (NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS with the private CA). This lexical rule flags the assignment.
remediation: Delete the process-wide override, install the private CA in the trust store, and keep NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS with the private CA.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the assignment; an override used only by a throwaway local script is reviewed case by case.
